newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Duratex started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Duratex started as buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it has started coverage of leading local building materials producer Duratex, a member of Brazil's Itau Group, with a buy rating.
-- The brokerage said increased building activity and expansion in the furniture industry is boosting Duratex's earnings.
-- Fator also cited the company's cash pile, which stood at 139 million reais in September, an amount equal to 38 percent of its market capitalization of 366.8 million reais.
-- The firm also has a low level of debt - 151.6 million reais or 23.7 percent of shareholder equity - with favorable loan rates, the brokerage said.

-- Duratex posted nine-month revenue of 350.8 million reais, up 2.7 percent from the same period last year, while net income dropped 8.7 percent to 23.2 million in the period due to smaller first-quarter profit, the brokerage said.
-- Higher furniture sales in Brazil, the result of favorable credit conditions, also is boosting Duratex sales, it said.
-- "Combined with a more active economy and distribution of fixed costs, this is leading to higher profits," Fator said.
-- Duratex preferred was flat at 39.90 reais at 1141 local/0841 EST on the Sao Paulo bourse. Its common voter was untraded at 32.12 reais, its Oct 22 closing price.
